description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of question types across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. The chart is composed of three separate pie charts, one for each difficulty level, and a total of five categories are represented across all charts: N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, N+K-, and CoT. The “easy” chart contains four slices, with proportions of 40.6% (green), 45.9% (orange), 10.1% (yellow), and 3.3% (red). The “medium” chart also has four slices, representing 44.6% (green), 44.3% (orange), 7.2% (yellow), and 3.9% (red). The “hard” chart contains five slices, with proportions of 36.2% (green), 20.1% (blue), 7.0% (yellow), 36.8% (orange), and 0.0% (red). A legend is provided, labeling each category with a corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices within each pie chart appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion, moving clockwise.
